name: figma-to-roblox-ui
description: Import Figma designs into Roblox Studio with scale-only layouts and faithful artwork.

interface.shortDescription: Turn Figma designs into responsive Roblox UI.
interface.longDescription: A skill for importing Figma designs into Roblox Studio with scale-only layout, centered anchors, scaled strokes and corners, exported artwork, and visual validation. Configure Figma and Roblox Studio MCP connections separately for live imports.
defaultPrompt: Import this Figma design into Roblox Studio using the figma-to-roblox-ui skill.
